description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 or 1.60 each), grants [Awoken Height of Evil Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Twin Element Mode II (Holy, Dark)] and [Monochrome Syndrome] to the user

description.name: Awoken Height of Evil Mode
description.text: Dark and Holy abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts Delta Storm after using a Holy or Dark ability

description.name: Twin Element Mode II (Holy, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Holy with Stacking]/[Attach Dark with Stacking] after using a Holy/Dark ability

description.name: Monochrome Syndrome
description.text: Grants [Dark/Holy Ability +30% Boost 1] to user after using two Holy or Dark Abilities
